title: Han conquest of Nanyue
description: Han armies destroy the kingdom of Nanyue, bringing the Red River Delta under Chinese rule for about a thousand years.

title: Rebellion of the Trưng sisters
description: Trưng Trắc and Trưng Nhị lead a rising that drives out the Han governor and rule for three years before a Han army defeats them.

title: Battle of Bạch Đằng
description: Ngô Quyền destroys a Southern Han fleet on stakes planted in the river, ending Chinese rule.

title: Đinh Bộ Lĩnh founds Đại Cồ Việt
description: After defeating rival warlords Đinh Bộ Lĩnh takes the title of emperor and sets his capital at Hoa Lư.

title: Capital moved to Thăng Long
description: Lý Thái Tổ, founder of the Lý dynasty, moves the capital to the site of modern Hanoi.

title: Temple of Literature founded
description: A temple to Confucius is built in the capital; the academy attached to it trains officials for seven centuries.

title: Battle of Bạch Đằng
description: Trần Hưng Đạo traps and destroys the Yuan fleet, ending the third and last Mongol invasion.

title: Ming conquest
description: Ming armies overthrow the Hồ dynasty and annex the country as a Chinese province for twenty years.

title: Lê Lợi founds the Lê dynasty
description: After a ten-year rising from Lam Sơn the Ming withdraw and Lê Lợi takes the throne.

title: Fall of Vijaya
description: Lê Thánh Tông takes the Cham capital, reducing Champa to a remnant and opening the south to Vietnamese settlement.

title: Trịnh–Nguyễn War begins
description: The Trịnh lords of the north attack the Nguyễn lords of the south, beginning a division of the country that lasts until the 1770s.

title: Tây Sơn rebellion begins
description: Three brothers begin a rising that overthrows both the Nguyễn and the Trịnh lords and then the Lê dynasty.

title: Battle of Ngọc Hồi-Đống Đa
description: Nguyễn Huệ attacks during the New Year festival and routs a Qing army sent to restore the Lê.

title: Gia Long unifies Vietnam
description: Nguyễn Ánh defeats the Tây Sơn, takes the name Gia Long and rules a united country from Huế as first emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty.

title: French attack on Đà Nẵng
description: A French and Spanish squadron lands at Đà Nẵng, beginning the French conquest.

title: Treaty of Saigon
description: Emperor Tự Đức cedes Saigon and three southern provinces to France, the beginning of the colony of Cochinchina.

title: Treaty of Huế
description: The court accepts a French protectorate over Annam and Tonkin.

title: French Indochina formed
description: France joins Cochinchina, Annam, Tonkin and Cambodia in a single Indochinese Union.

title: Communist Party founded
description: Hồ Chí Minh brings rival communist groups together in one party at a meeting in Hong Kong.

title: Yên Bái mutiny
description: A rising of Vietnamese soldiers organised by the Nationalist Party is crushed and the party's leaders are guillotined.

title: Declaration of independence
description: After the August Revolution Hồ Chí Minh proclaims the Democratic Republic of Vietnam in Ba Đình Square.

title: First Indochina War begins
description: Việt Minh forces attack the French in Hanoi, opening eight years of war.

title: Geneva Accords
description: France agrees to withdraw and Vietnam is divided for the time being at the 17th parallel.

title: Republic of Vietnam proclaimed
description: Ngô Đình Diệm deposes Emperor Bảo Đại by referendum and declares a republic in the south.

title: Diệm overthrown
description: Army officers overthrow and kill President Ngô Đình Diệm after months of Buddhist protest.

title: Gulf of Tonkin incident
description: A clash between North Vietnamese boats and an American destroyer leads the United States Congress to authorise open war.

title: Tet Offensive
description: Communist forces attack towns across the south during the New Year truce; they are beaten back but American support for the war falls.

title: Paris Peace Accords
description: The United States agrees to withdraw its forces, leaving the two Vietnamese sides in place.

title: Fall of Saigon
description: North Vietnamese tanks enter the presidential palace and the southern government surrenders, ending the war.

title: Reunification
description: North and South are formally joined as the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.

title: Invasion of Cambodia
description: Vietnam invades Cambodia and within two weeks drives the Khmer Rouge from Phnom Penh; its army stays until 1989.

title: Sino-Vietnamese War
description: China invades the northern border provinces for a month in answer to the invasion of Cambodia.

title: Đổi Mới reforms
description: The Sixth Party Congress begins the move from a planned to a market economy.

title: Relations with the United States restored
description: The United States and Vietnam establish diplomatic relations twenty years after the war, in the year Vietnam joins ASEAN.
